description: Use this when someone plans a patio, walkway or driveway of pavers and asks how many pavers, how much base gravel or sand they need. Calculates the pavers for a patio, a walk or a driveway (a rectangle, a circle or a given area): the area in square meters, the waste in percent and the area with waste, pavers per square meter with their joints, and the pavers to buy, rounded up. Waste when not given: 5 % for running bond, stack bond and herringbone at 90° in a rectangle, 10 % for herringbone at 45° and a round area (Western Interlock: 5 to 10 %). It also gives the edge restraint in millimeters (the perimeter less the edge a wall or a curb holds) with its spikes, one every 609.6 mm for a patio and every 304.8 mm for a driveway (Snap Edge); the compacted base depth, by default the CMHA PAV-TEC-002 minimum on well-drained soil of 101.6 mm for patios and walks and 152.4 mm for driveways; and the bedding sand depth, 25.4 mm. base and sand are results of the gravel calculation (area, volume in liters, cubic feet and cubic yards, density, weight in kilograms and US short tons, bags by size): the base is loose crushed stone (1600 kg/m³) under the paved area widened past each restrained edge by 152.4 mm (Snap Edge) or the base depth where that is more (CMHA PAV-TEC-003 extends the base past the restraint by its thickness), with 36 % added for compaction (Wisconsin DOT report 0092-22-05 measured 36 to 47 %); the sand is damp loose sand (1690 kg/m³) under the paved area. edge and spikes are absent for a given area without a perimeter.

area.description: Paved area in square meters, used instead of the sizes; give perimeter for the edge restraint.

base.description: Depth of the compacted base; when left out 101.6 for a patio and 152.4 for a driveway, in millimeters.

compaction.description: Percent of loose base added to the compacted volume; 36 when left out.

diameter.description: Diameter of a round area, used instead of length and width, in millimeters.

fixed.description: Length of the edge of a rectangle or circle that a wall or a curb holds and that needs no edge restraint, in millimeters; 0 when left out.

joint.description: Joint between pavers added to the paver size, in millimeters; 0 when left out, as nominal sizes include it.

length.description: Length of a rectangular area, in millimeters.

pattern.description: running (running bond, the default), stack (stack bond), herringbone (at 90° to the edges), herringbone45 (at 45°).

paverLength.description: Length of one paver, its nominal size, in millimeters.

paverWidth.description: Width of one paver, its nominal size, in millimeters.

perimeter.description: Length of the edge to restrain, for an area given by area; without it there is no edge restraint, in millimeters.

sand.description: Depth of the bedding sand; 25.4 when left out, in millimeters.

use.description: patio (patios and walks, the default) or driveway; sets the least base depth and the spike spacing.

waste.description: Percent added to the pavers; when left out 5, or 10 for herringbone45 and a round area.

width.description: Width of a rectangular area, in millimeters.

name: calculate_pavers
title: Paver calculator
